name: confirm-dialog
description: A decision with an easy out. Cancel is quiet; confirm is the decision. Back and scrim are cancel.
avoidWhen: Do not use for a short status; use snackbar. Do not put a third button.

ux.behaviour: The title names the action; the body names the consequence
ux.why: You should know what happens before you tap

ux.behaviour: Confirm is text, or red text when destructive — never a red fill. Cancel is the quiet text button
ux.why: The easy out should look easy; the hard choice should not shout

ux.behaviour: Back and scrim call onDismiss, the same as cancel

aiHints: Pass destructive = true for delete; the confirm stays red text
onDismiss is cancel; do not treat scrim as confirm
